message.content:
The title of “best player” in soccer is highly debated and often depends on criteria such as current form, influence on the pitch, trophies won, or individual awards. As of mid‑2026, many pundits still consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top contenders:

| Player | Current Club | Recent Highlights |
|--------|--------------|-------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Inter Miami (MLS) | 2025 MLS MVP, 2026 Copa América winner with Argentina, continued high goal‑scoring and play‑making in the MLS and international fixtures. |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain (PSG) | 2025 Ligue 1 top scorer, 2026 FIFA World Cup finalist with France, record‑breaking transfer to PSG in 2024, and consistent performances in Champions League matches. |

Other players frequently mentioned include **Erling Haaland** (Manchester City), **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City), and **Neymar Jr.** (Al‑Hilal). Ultimately, the “best” player can vary depending on whether you value club success, international achievements, individual skill, or overall impact on the game.
